title: One of Crunchyroll’s Highest-Rated Series Is Officially a Hit After Latest Update
content: The Summer 2026 anime season has already released all the new series, and the lineup is more exciting than ever. Just like every other season, Crunchyroll added dozens of upcoming series to its library and began streaming new episodes weekly after the Japanese broadcast.
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Years Later, Acclaimed Shonen Jump Series Finally Returns With a New U.S. Release
content: D.Gray-man is considered one of the best Shonen Jump series of all time thanks to its captivating storytelling and exceptional cast of characters. Written and illustrated by Katsura Hoshino, the manga debuted in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2004 but transitioned to Shueisha’s Jump Square Rise in 2018.
author: ComicBook

title: Shinobi Undercover Manga Gets Novel
content: Shueisha is listing a novel for Ippon Takegushi and Santa Mitarashi 's Shinobi Undercover ( Shinobigoto ) manga titled Shinobigoto A Day in the Life Birds , with a slated release date of September 4. Kiyoko Hoshi is wiring the novel.
author: ANN

title: Magical Explorer Anime Reveals First Trailer, Key Visual, October 2026 Release
content: Magical Explorer: Reborn as a Side Character in a Fantasy Dating Sim anime revealed a key visual, trailer, as well as an October 2026 release date. Studio WHITE FOX is handling the animation, with Kazuki Ohashi as the director. The anime was first announced in September 2023.
author: Anime Corner

title: MVM Adds From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated!
content: From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated! premiered on MBS and TBS and its 28 affiliate channels in the Super Animeism TURBO programming block on January 9. Muse India describes the anime: Kenzaburo Tondabayashi, a 52-year-old diligent public employee, died after a traffic incident… Or that was what's…
author: ANN

title: Socrates in Love's Kazumi Kazui Launches New Manga
content: The September issue of Shogakukan 's Petit Comic magazine revealed last Friday that Kazumi Kazui will launch a new manga titled Anata no Koto ga Ki ni Iranai (I Do Not Fancy You) in the magazine's next issue on September 8. The manga will have a color opening page, and the first chapter will have 54 pages.
author: ANN

title: emaqi Service Adds New 7 Manga, 18 Viz Media Titles
content: AI localization company Orange Inc. announced on Friday that its emaqi e-bookstore service is adding seven exclusive new titles this month. Six of the new titles will be available through its " emaqi Premium" monthly subscription service.
author: ANN

title: K MANGA Adds Camp Master Extraordinaire
content: K MANGA added Yuno Yozakura and Ryōsuke Sano 's Camp Master Extraordinaire ( Isekai Gourmet Nariagari Musō: Yama ni Tsuihō Sareta node, Nonbiri Camp o Tanoshinde Itara Itsunomanika Tsuyoku Natteite, Ōkō Kizoku ya Jitsuryokusha-tachi ga Ore o Hōtte Oite Kuremasen.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Summer 2026 Shonen Action Anime Perfectly Subverts One Major Shonen Hero Trope
content: Every new anime season usually has a shonen series that perfectly embodies the genre’s core tropes, and Summer 2026 is no different with Black Torch , currently airing on Crunchyroll .
author: ComicBook

title: Twin Engine, Bandai Launch New Manga Platform Bibibi Comic
content: Anime planning and production company Twin Engine launched a new manga platform called Bibibi Comic with Bandai Co., Ltd. as part of their previously announced strategic partnership. Users can read titles with free tickets after completing missions, as well as one free chapter every 23 hours.
author: ANN
